data.title: A Warm Spot

premise.hero_want: Safa wants to help a thin cat on a cold step.
premise.problem: The cat has no warm spot to sit.
premise.mechanism: Safa takes her bun from its paper bag and lays the empty bag on the step as a warm mat.
premise.resolution: The cat sits on the bag, and Safa is glad.

key_objects.name: Hot bun
key_objects.description: A small, round bun from the bakery.

key_objects.name: Paper bag
key_objects.description: A plain paper bakery bag that Safa lays flat on the step.

cast.who: Safa, a five-year-old Muslim Jordanian girl
cast.appearance: Dark hair, a long-sleeved coral tunic, loose blue trousers and flat shoes; knees and shoulders covered; solid black filled oval eyes.
Short ginger fur, a long tail and solid black filled oval eyes.

pages.text: Safa has a hot bun in a bag. A thin cat is on a step.
pages.scene: In one quiet Amman lane, Safa stands by steep pale stone steps with the bun inside its paper bag. The thin ginger cat sits on the lowest step. A bakery doorway nearby suggests a warm bread smell. All visible eyes are solid black filled ovals.

pages.text: Safa gets the bun. Then she puts the bag on the step.
pages.scene: Safa holds the bun safely in one hand and lays the empty paper bag flat on the lowest step with the other. The cat watches. All visible eyes are solid black filled ovals.

pages.text: The cat sits on the bag.
pages.scene: The ginger cat sits on the flat paper bag. Safa remains beside the same step, holding her bun. All visible eyes are solid black filled ovals.

pages.text: Safa sits with the cat. She has the hot bun.

pages.text: The cat has a warm spot. Safa is glad.

data.cold_read: The story meets the blocking requirements: it is logical, safe, fully decodable, visually consistent and clearly driven by Safa. It keeps one thread, no adult, two key objects and one ordinary physical mechanism. Only the final line needs a small wording adjustment.
